conditions.lost_finding_summary: Lost S != O != E principle: test harness treats URL hash presence (#return-review) as proof of visual rendering.

conditions.notes: Without FADT, UI developers prematurely expose action buttons when conditioning is missing.

differentiated_contribution_summary.ATLAS: Indispensable for multi-receiver continuity, predecessor digest chaining, and fork exclusion.
